intent: Behaviour-preserving refactor to clear 13 SonarQube findings: the high-complexity functions in internal/backup.go (runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig, checkProvider, Run, checkProvidersDefined) are split into helpers, the three copies of the backup-status notification title move behind backupStatusTitle in internal/notify.go, a duplicate GitLab test is deleted, TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup gets assertion helpers, and docker/Dockerfile is tidied. The stated contract is that runtime behaviour and log output are unchanged, so any observable difference from the base counts as a regression.

findings.title: Refactored Run/backup dispatch path unexecuted without live credentials
findings.suggested_fix: Add an offline Run()-level test next to TestGithubRepositoryBackupWithMockAPI in internal/github_mock_test.go that reuses newGitFixtureServer and newGitHubMockAPI: back up/restore the environment (backupEnvironmentVariables/restoreEnvironmentVariables), call unsetEnvVarsExcept([]string{envPath}), explicitly unset GIT_BACKUP_INTERVAL and GIT_BACKUP_CRON (TestGetBackupInterval leaves GIT_BACKUP_INTERVAL set, and a non-zero value would block in waitForShutdown) plus the notification variables, then set GIT_BACKUP_DIR=t.TempDir(), GITHUB_TOKEN=mock-token, GITHUB_APIURL=<mock api URL>; call Run() and assert NoError, exactly one bundle under <backupDir>/github.com/mockuser/<name> for each repo, and that <backupDir>/.working has been removed. Assumption: GitHub() keeps honouring GITHUB_APIURL (internal/github.go:33), which the scratch prototype confirmed.
findings.why_it_matters: A green test run says nothing about the largest part of this refactor unless provider credentials are present: every test that drives Run() to success skips without a live token, so the new collectProviderBackupResults, createWorkingDir, scheduleBackups and runProviderBackups code is never executed (0% statement coverage at the reviewed head). A wrong env-var/provider pairing in the new dispatch table, a dropped working-directory step, or an early return in Run would ship with the suite passing. The repo already owns offline fixtures (newGitFixtureServer/newGitHubMockAPI) but TestGithubRepositoryBackupWithMockAPI calls githosts directly and bypasses Run(); routing a sibling test through Run() covers the refactored one-shot path deterministically, and a prototype of exactly that passed offline in about 5s in a scratch copy.
evidence: internal/github_mock_test.go:138 -- result := githubHost.Backup()  (the only deterministic backup test calls githosts directly; it never enters Run(), runProviderBackups or GitHub())

Coverage of the reviewed head (scratch copy of 136a4850, `go test ./internal/ -count=1 -coverprofile`, no credentials): collectProviderBackupResults 0.0%, runProviderBackups 0.0%, createWorkingDir 0.0%, scheduleBackups 0.0%, runScheduledJob 0.0%, execProviderBackups 0.0%, validateStartupConfig 46.7% (success return at backup.go:470 uncovered), Run 64.3% (backup.go:417-421 uncovered)

internal/backup_test.go:552-553 -- if os.Getenv(envGitLabToken) == "" { t.Skipf(...) }  (same guard pattern on every test that reaches a successful Run(); the only Run() calls that execute offline are the two early-error tests at backup_test.go:243 and :819)

Scratch prototype (TestScratchRunOneShotWithMockGitHub: Run() against the existing mock GraphQL API and git fixture server) passed offline and raised collectProviderBackupResults to 87.5%, createWorkingDir to 85.7%, runProviderBackups to 72.7%, scheduleBackups to 58.3%
No workflow under .github/workflows runs `go test` (grep count 0); the Makefile `test` target is the only runner, so there is no credentialed CI run compensating for the skips

residual_risks: Informational, no fix needed: the claim that log output is unchanged holds except for two narrow, log-only differences from base c77f548. Neither changes which providers run or what is backed up. (1) internal/backup.go:101 evaluates `bitbucketAPITokenDefined() || bitbucketOAuthDefined()`, which stops at the first true result; the base read all five BitBucket variables on every backup run. With complete BitBucket API-token credentials plus a BITBUCKET_USER_FILE, BITBUCKET_KEY_FILE or BITBUCKET_SECRET_FILE that points at an unreadable file, the `file ... does not exist` / `error opening file` line from GetEnvOrFile (internal/envfile.go:35-39) is logged once per backup run (from Bitbucket(), internal/bitbucket.go:19-21) instead of twice; it still appears at startup. Established by reading, not executed. (2) internal/backup.go:219 now logs the BitBucket compare method through the shared strings.EqualFold check, where the base used strings.ToLower(compare) == "refs". A BITBUCKET_COMPARE value that matches only under Unicode simple folding (for example "ref" followed by U+017F) is logged as `refs` instead of `clone`; ASCII values are unaffected. This was the only output difference in the adversarial reviewer's randomized base-vs-head run over 40,000 environment configurations. Noted by correctness, testing, maintainability, reliability and adversarial (one model, so agreement adds no confidence).

Informational: two restructured runtime paths were checked by reading only, because they need provider credentials or block on a signal. They are the scheduled path (GIT_BACKUP_INTERVAL / GIT_BACKUP_CRON -> scheduleBackups -> runScheduledJob, internal/backup.go:491-541) and the non-GitHub entries of the provider dispatch in collectProviderBackupResults (internal/backup.go:97-123). By inspection the provider order (BitBucket, Gitea, GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Sourcehut) and predicates match the base, runScheduledJob assigns the package-level `job` without shadowing it (internal/backup.go:528), and the job options keep their original order. The new assertion helpers of TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup (dirHasEntryWithPrefix, assertGiteaOrgTwoOnlyBackedUp, assertGiteaAllOrgsBackedUp; internal/backup_test.go:641, 651, 665) compiled but never ran, since that test skips without Gitea credentials; their equivalence to the removed inline assertions also rests on reading. Noted by correctness, testing, reliability and adversarial.
testing_gaps: Startup configuration log output: no test asserts any line written by displayStartupConfig (internal/backup.go:190) or its new label-parameterised helpers logProviderOrgs (:203), logProviderBackupsToKeep (:210), logProviderCompareMethod (:217) and logProviderBackupLFS (:227), including the deliberately preserved `Organistations` spelling (:205). Equivalence with the base was shown only outside the repository, by the reviewers' scratch differential runs (byte-identical output over 6,000 to 40,000 random environments). A table test that swaps the package-level `logger` for a buffer and sets provider variables with t.Setenv would pin the "log output unchanged" contract.

Scheduled mode: no test drives Run() with GIT_BACKUP_INTERVAL or GIT_BACKUP_CRON, so the interval and cron branches of scheduleBackups (internal/backup.go:501-515) and runScheduledJob (internal/backup.go:525-541) never execute. Nothing verifies that the package-level `job` is still assigned through the new helper; execProviderBackups (internal/backup.go:35) relies on it to avoid os.Exit(1) after a failed backup in daemon mode, and runProviderBackups (internal/backup.go:87) uses it for the next-run banner.

Provider credential validation: the error branches moved into checkJustTokenProvider (blank token, internal/backup.go:357-359) and checkUserAndPasswordProvider (partially configured provider, internal/backup.go:381-386) are not executed by the suite; only the `no providers defined` outcome is asserted (internal/backup_test.go:787-801).

Notification titles: the new backupStatusTitle switch (internal/notify.go:31-39), which supplies the title for the Telegram, ntfy and Slack messages (internal/notify.go:104, 191, 216), has no test. There is no current regression: the three title literals are byte-identical to the base and the switch matches the three removed copies. A four-row table test (for example TestBackupStatusTitle in a new internal/notify_test.go) asserting (1,0) -> succeeded, (3,2) -> completed with errors, (0,2) -> failed and (0,0) -> failed against literal strings would pin it. This was candidate #3 (P3, testing), moved here before validation.

coverage.verdict_reasoning: No behavioural regression was found in the refactor: five reviewers and their base-vs-head differential runs found the provider dispatch, startup validation, scheduling and notification titles equivalent to base c77f548, apart from two narrow log-only differences recorded under residual_risks. There is no P0 or P1. The one open finding is #1 (P2, confirmed by the validator): every restructured function on the backup path is unexecuted when the suite runs without provider credentials, and no workflow runs the tests with credentials, so the green run at the reviewed head (`go test ./internal/ -count=1` -> ok) does not exercise this change. The fix is one offline Run()-level test built on fixtures the repository already has.
coverage.fix_order: #1 only: add the offline Run() test in internal/github_mock_test.go. Nothing else is queued.

per_finding.title: Extracted createWorkingDir duplicates existing resolveWorkingDir helper
per_finding.reason: The duplication predates the diff and is unchanged by it: base c77f548 already has resolveWorkingDir at internal/backup.go:129 (6adadb6b) alongside the inline `workingDIR := os.Getenv(envGitWorkingDir)` block at internal/backup.go:421 (476ed841), and 136a4850 only wraps those same lines verbatim in createWorkingDir (blame attributes backup.go:474-478 to 476ed841, only the func line 473 to 136a4850), so the diff neither introduces nor worsens the two-copies condition and the finding's pre_existing:false is contradicted by its own provenance; the create/cleanup path divergence it warns of is a hypothetical future edit, not a behaviour present at the reviewed head, where both copies return identical values.
per_finding.report_leaf_check: Read-only inspection agrees with the rejection: base c77f548 has resolveWorkingDir at internal/backup.go:129 and the inline working-directory block at internal/backup.go:421, and blame at the reviewed head attributes internal/backup.go:474-478 to 476ed841 and only the func line 473 to 136a4850.
